steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json containing the application name 'How Are You' and the package identifier 'com.howareyou.app'.

steps.title: Define Gradle Project Structure
steps.description: Establish the build configuration with Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2 supporting Java 17 and SDK 34 compatibility.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Write AndroidManifest.xml specifying com.howareyou.app package namespace, launcher activity, and app metadata.

steps.title: Design Interactive User Interface Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml using native widgets with elegant card styling to present the primary question 'How are you?' and response choices.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity Class
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java under package com.howareyou.app, setting up layout views and UI components.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Response Logic
steps.description: Bind click listeners to reaction buttons (Amazing, Good, Tired, Sad) using anonymous inner classes to capture how the user is doing.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic Quote Generator
steps.description: Add dynamic feedback messages that offer motivation, support, or celebration based on the user's mood selection.

steps.title: Apply Native Material Theme
steps.description: Apply standard lightweight system material styles to maintain an attractive aesthetic without third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Declarations
steps.description: Double check all xmlns references, activity setups, and configuration settings in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Building How Are You
steps.description: Assemble and compile the debug application package (APK) using Java 17 and AGP 8.3.2 build system.
